short_description: Handle consumer enquiries across channels, quote clearly, verify deposits/availability, and reduce no-shows.

questions.question: Which channels bring in consumer enquiries and where are they recorded?
What details are needed to understand the service requested and customer availability?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Service option, preferred dates/times, location or branch, special requests...

questions.question: How are prices, eligibility and service options communicated?
options: Published menu/pricing page or standard price sheet
Staff type out custom quotes in DMs or WhatsApp each time

questions.question: Who checks availability and confirms the booking?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Front desk / coordinator checks staff rota and confirms slot...

questions.question: What deposit, payment or cancellation conditions apply?
options: Automated deposit payment required at booking with clear cancellation policy
Manual bank transfer link sent; booking held loosely until paid
No deposit required — pay on arrival

questions.question: How are reminders and preparation instructions sent?
options: Staff manually text reminders the evening before

questions.question: What happens when the customer does not respond, cancels or changes the booking?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Slot held until morning or waitlist checked manually...

short_description: Confirm booking readiness, allocate staff & equipment, verify completion standards, and capture post-visit feedback.

questions.question: What information confirms that a booking is complete and ready for delivery?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Confirmed slot, deposit paid, customer prep form/notes complete...

questions.question: How do you prepare staff, materials, equipment or location?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Coordinator checks next-day bookings each afternoon and preps kit/room...

questions.question: Who assigns the person delivering the service and confirms availability?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Operations manager matches staff skill and shift schedule...

questions.question: What checklist or standard defines a completed service?
options: Written service completion checklist signed off by specialist
Informal verbal standard — varies by staff member

questions.question: How are delays, customer changes or service exceptions handled?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Staff message coordinator to adjust schedule or notify next customer...

questions.question: Who records completion and any follow-up required?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Practitioner marks booking complete in system and adds aftercare note...

questions.question: How is feedback or a complaint linked to the original booking?
options: Automated post-visit feedback linked to booking ID & staff member
Reviewed in Google reviews or DMs without linking to the booking record

short_description: Log consumer complaints cleanly, define frontline resolution limits, escalate to managers, and fix root causes.

questions.question: Where can customers raise complaints and how are they logged?
options: Social media comments / DMs / Google reviews

questions.question: What information is collected to understand the issue?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Booking reference, service date, staff involved, photos/description...

questions.question: Who decides priority and whether a manager must intervene?
options: Written severity tiers (safety/refund/public review triggers immediate manager review)
Frontline staff handle what they can and pass angry cases to owner/manager

questions.question: What resolution options are permitted and who can approve exceptions?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Frontline can offer complimentary redo/voucher up to £25; cash refunds need manager approval...

questions.question: How does the customer receive progress updates?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Coordinator emails/calls within 24h while investigating...

questions.question: How is customer acceptance or unresolved dissatisfaction recorded?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Closed in complaint log once customer confirms satisfaction...

questions.question: How are recurring causes reviewed and assigned for improvement?
options: Monthly review of complaint themes with team training/process updates
Discussed ad hoc when the same issue happens repeatedly

short_description: Identify timely repeat-booking triggers, respect consent preferences, personalise outreach, and track retention.

questions.question: What event or customer need indicates a follow-up is appropriate?
questions.placeholder: e.g. 6 weeks after last appointment, package completion, seasonal service cycle...

questions.question: How do you identify customers due for a repeat service without contacting the wrong people?
options: Booking system segments active vs lapsed customers and excludes open complaints
Export customer list to spreadsheet and filter manually
Blast all past customers with generic promo messages

questions.question: What consent and contact preferences are recorded?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Marketing opt-in flag & preferred channel (SMS vs email) in booking profile...

questions.question: Who decides the message, offer and timing?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Marketing/manager sets standard templates and timing intervals...

questions.question: How are responses, bookings and opt-outs recorded?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Link tracks bookings automatically; unsubscribes synced to profile...

questions.question: What happens when a customer needs personal advice or a tailored recommendation?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Handed over to specialist/consultant for personal call or message...

questions.question: How do you measure repeat booking and customer retention?
options: Track monthly rebooking rate & repeat revenue in booking system
Roughly gauge how many familiar faces return
